decisions.reason: A rye country bread is a core staple for a traditional German bakery, costs little to keep in a range made from shared rye doughs, and shows no sign of trouble.
The premium raisin stollen won the German Bread Institute gold medal again, which makes it a flagship seasonal and gift product.
A seeded rye mixed bread meets steady demand for wholesome breads and fits the existing production easily.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant, but it uses the established rye know-how and is cheap to keep in a medium range.
Marzipan stollen is a classic Christmas gift item that sells alongside the award-winning stollen line and the online gift business.
The ancient grain bread was promoted as the newest masterpiece and answers health and regional-grain trends, so the firm is likely to give it time.
